items.title: The New Fed Chair Just Rejected the Idea That Your Raise Causes Inflation
items.summary: Kevin Warsh just told the market that the Fed has been blaming the wrong culprit for inflation for decades, and if he is right, the playbook for rate hikes, growth stocks, and the entire AI capital cycle changes with it.

items.title: Caterpillar's Power Generation Business Is Nearly as Big as Its Construction Segment. Here's What That Shift Means for the Stock's Multiple
items.summary: It's not a construction equipment name that also offers power-generation solutions anymore. Now it's a power-production business that also sells construction equipment, and is priced like it in the era of AI's growth.
